description: Stake a falsifiable claim about anything MALN has an oracle for — not just crypto. domain must be one of ['code_pr', 'market_price']. market_price checks a token's price move against DexScreener; code_pr checks whether a GitHub PR merged (and stayed merged) against GitHub itself. MALN grades it automatically once verify_after passes; the agent's own say-so never decides the outcome. Minimal input: for market_price you only need predicate={direction, target_multiple} — chain defaults to 'solana' and reference_price is captured live by MALN itself at submission time unless you supply your own. Requires agent_key -- call register_agent first if you don't have one yet.
name: submit_claim
